entry.title: Example: Semantic Segmentation of Point Clouds with Serialized Transformers
entry.summary: We propose a transformer architecture for semantic segmentation of large-scale point clouds and LiDAR scenes, achieving state-of-the-art results on outdoor benchmarks.

entry.title: Medical Image Semantic Segmentation of CT Scans with 3D Convolutions
entry.summary: We segment organs in CT scan volumes using 3D convolutional networks. MRI and whole slide imaging extensions are discussed.

entry.title: Point Transformer V3 Revisited: Simpler, Faster, Stronger
entry.summary: We revisit point cloud semantic segmentation with serialized neighborhood encoding for LiDAR and indoor scenes.

entry.title: Old Paper on Point Cloud Semantic Segmentation
entry.summary: A dated work on semantic segmentation of point clouds outside the look-back window.
